title: a voxel browser game in under 50 KB, built with Claude Code
author: emersoftware
selftext:
i used Claude Code to develop the game in JavaScript on Phaser 3. the rule was that the whole game had to be under 50 KB, so there are no image assets. with Claude Code i implemented a software renderer on top of Phaser 3, and the 3D voxel terrain, the ships and the sound are all generated in code



the game is set in Chile, 2075. the planet is 3 degrees warmer, wildfires burn the forests, and extreme rains flood the rivers and cause mudslides. the drones that managed the crisis stopped obeying



you play as a Darwin's frog and a monito del monte who pilot ships. you have 3 tasks: put out fires with a bucket you fill by skimming low over a river or the sea, rescue people from the banks of flooded rivers, and shoot down drones. it runs in the browser, for 1 player or 2 on the same keyboard



play: [https://2075.emersoftware.cl](https://2075.emersoftware.cl)



if you like it, you can vote until 23:59 Chile time (UTC-3) today, nov 20: [https://hack.platan.us/26/arcade/2075](https://hack.platan.us/26/arcade/2075)
